haiku.problem: Verse 3-4 says "we" (Paul and his co-workers), not "believers" in general. The question changes who is speaking.
Verse 5 says "we" (Paul and his co-workers) take every thought captive, not "believers" in general. The question changes who is speaking.
The verses never say the words are Scripture. Verse 17 gives them as a quoted saying, so "quoted Scripture" comes from outside the passage text.
